title: Power BI autodeployment UX fixes: clearing records should affect only the selected + reorganizing actions
summary: Power BI auto-deployment functionality now clears only selected deployment records instead of all records, and actions on the deployment page have been reorganized.
key_points: Clearing deployment records now affects only the selected deployment, not all of them
Actions on the Power BI Report Deployments page were reorganized at the request of product management
PBI Deployment Events, the Power BI Deployment tables and the Power BI Subscribers codeunit were updated to support this
Power BI synchronizer tests were extended
quote: When clearing deployment records to clear the state in Business Central, only the selected one is affected, instead of all of them
